related_resources.reason: Second-order tests for constrained optimization with active inequalities.
Distinguishes LICQ and MFCQ and consequences for multiplier existence.

authorship.scope: Original standalone narrated mathematics, derivations, worked constrained optimization examples, and non-spoken companions; earlier manuscripts unchanged.

prerequisites.reason: Feasible tangent geometry and Lagrangian curvature.

recommended.reason: Convex KKT certificates and Slater conditions.

background: Scalar inequalities, two-dimensional feasible regions, first and second derivatives, local minima.
readiness_checks: Can you distinguish an active constraint from a positive multiplier?
Can you find a feasible direction that changes when an active set switches?

description: Introduces feasible-direction and critical cones, complementary slackness, and multiplier conditions, showing why active-set changes complicate local optimality tests.
